verbalization: The visible evidence suggests a potential relationship between Bremelanotide and A2780cisR through a series of molecular interactions. Bremelanotide is predicted to target the IgG receptor FcRn large subunit p51, which is known to be a target of Dl-Anabasine. This implies that Bremelanotide may exert its effects by modulating the activity of FcRn, thereby influencing the degradation of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the body. The subsequent interaction of Dl-Anabasine with A2780cisR indicates that the pathway involving FcRn may be a critical mediator of the biological effects of Dl-Anabasine on this cell line. The scores indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, suggesting that further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Bremelanotide and A2780cisR.
